title: 第9章
slug: 澶墠鍎垮瓙鍤ｅ紶濡堝挭
content_zh: 第一章 酒吧相遇这几天，关于星空与欧慕瑄的绯闻一直没断过，叶芊沫早就已经生出了免疫力，任外面报道乱飞，她悠然地在家画着自己的设计图。今天早上，新闻的方向似乎有了重大的变化，所有的报纸头条上，都是关于顾佳泞的绯闻报道！当红女星顾佳泞借身体上位！为赢得片约，顾佳泞不惜献身投资商！顾佳泞毫无演技，只靠潜规则走红！一则则毒辣的娱乐新闻凭空降临，每一条都能将一个当红的艺人打入十八层地狱！报道上，不禁图文并茂说得煞有其事，而且还有各种顾佳泞之前与很多投资商吃饭的照片，这年头，明星为了赢得投资商的亲睐而牺牲色相，似乎已经成了娱乐圈的潜规则，然而顾佳泞最多也就陪着吃个饭，其他的事情，她宁可不出演这部戏，接拍这个广告，也绝对不会去做。她的合约到期了，新的经纪公司还没有与之签约，没有公司的庇护，顾佳泞只有被动挨打的份！叶芊沫担心顾佳泞，于是开车来到她所住的公寓，然而还未足够靠近，便被堵在门口的记者团团围住。“星空小姐，请问您是来安慰顾小姐吗？”“关于最近发生的事情，您怎么看？”“听说你们情同姐妹，您会帮顾小姐吗？”“欧氏的传媒业几乎占据了本市的所有市场，您会去求欧总的帮忙吗？”欧氏的传媒业有那么厉害么？那么这次突然降临的绯闻……叶芊沫突然想到欧慕瑄说的，他会让她求他，难道是用这种办法来逼她？卑鄙，无耻！冲破了记者重围，叶芊沫来到顾佳泞的公寓，原本以为她会缩在角落里哭泣，就算不缩在角落，至少也会痛哭流涕吧，然而她看的到的却是……这丫头脸上贴着黄瓜片，一边听着音乐，一边在做瑜伽！抬眼看到叶芊沫，顾佳泞张口吃掉嘴边的黄瓜片，“姐，你看我这个动作标不标准？”“你在做什么？”叶芊沫大跌眼镜，她为她担心得要死，结果当事人根本没当回事？“瑜伽啊！”叶芊沫扯掉她的耳机，瞪着她，“你知道外面的报道吗？”“知道啊，”顾佳泞坐起身体，“没事，那些事我又没做，随他们说，等他们说腻了，自然就住口了，我站出来解释，只会越描越黑。”在娱乐圈这么多年，她坦坦荡荡，才不会畏惧别人的造谣。“等他们说够了，你也差不多死透了！”在娱乐圈，一个明星的声誉是很重要的，一旦臭名昭著，想要再红起来就很难了。顾佳泞坐起身，揭掉脸上的黄瓜，一改往日的嬉皮笑脸，一脸认真地看着叶芊沫，“我知道这次有人故意陷害的，我在娱乐圈的敌人不少，他们趁机踩我是很正常的。”“其实……”“不过他们要踩我，最好能把我踩死，不然一旦我站起来，我必然会让他们付出更大的代价，”狠话说完，顾佳泞转而一笑，“嘿嘿，这是你教我的！”“对不起佳泞，这件事……是我连累你了。”叶芊沫愧疚地转过头。“姐？”顾佳泞不懂。“欧慕瑄让想让我用求他的方式进欧氏的女装部，我拒绝了，所以，他想利用你来让我去求他，对不起佳泞。”“……”顾佳泞愣住了。“不过佳泞，你放心，我会有办法的，相信我！”漆黑的眸子里有盛大的光芒，坚定得如同一棵百年大树。“办法？”顾佳泞轻笑，“什么办法？牺牲你的自尊，你的骄傲去求那个人渣？”“我……”如果有需要，她可以！顾佳泞握住叶芊沫的手，“姐，如果你还把我当妹妹，就不要去管这件事，如果你敢去求她，我就退出娱乐圈！”“佳泞！”叶芊沫惊愕地看着她。“哎呦姐，你太小题大做了，这次不过是一个无足轻重的绯闻而已，没那么严重真的，”顾佳泞一副毫不在意的样子，“在娱乐圈混了这么久，多大的风浪我没经历过，这点是小事！”她越是宽容，越是为她着想，叶芊沫的心里就越自责，可恶的欧慕瑄！客厅里，小奶娃看着报纸，很是疑惑，爹地不是这么卑鄙的人吧？他那么骄傲，应该不屑于用这种办法来逼迫妈咪吧？略微思考了一下，小奶娃打开电脑，登陆上自己设计的聊天系统，发现欧慕瑄的头像是亮着的，于是，小奶娃给他发过去一则信息。沫沫家的宝贝：洛大少爷，在吗？一分钟过后，对方总算有了反应。沫沫家的保护神：这都是什么乱七八糟的名字！好吧，沫沫的保护神是小奶娃赐给自己亲爱爹地的名字，意思是要爹地向守护神一样保护着小奶娃的亲亲妈咪，而他的聊天头像，也是小奶娃给的，一个奶爸的完美形象。沫沫家的宝贝：凑合着用，不许改啊，不然我不敢保证你公司的文件不会出现在对手公司的电脑上。沫沫家的守护神：你觉得我会怕你的威胁？沫沫家的宝贝：不要改嘛，求你了，你就当是为了讨好我嘛！硬的不行来软的，该撒娇的时候，小奶娃从来不会吝啬的，尤其是对方还是自己盼了很久的爹地大人。沫沫家的守护神：我为什么要讨好你，你又不是我的谁？沫沫家的宝贝：看名字就知道，咱们是一家人啊。沫沫家的守护神：我是守护神，你宝贝，难道你是我儿子？沫沫家的宝贝：说不定你还真的是我爹地哦，要不要献出一滴血让我比对一下我们的DNA？会有人这么主动贬低自己做人家的儿子么？不过看得出来，对方没有恶意，而且还是在故意的讨好，只是为什么要讨好他？欧慕瑄不明白。沫沫家的守护神：DNA就不用验了，我认下你这个儿子了，找我什么事？就为了认爹？小奶娃嘟嘴，爹地，占人家便宜的时候一点也不知道手软，“看今天的报纸了吗？绯闻主角换了哦。”沫沫家的守护神：跟我有关系么？沫沫家的宝贝：难道不是欧总做的？沫沫家的守护神：我有那么无聊么？他是想利用顾佳泞，不过不是这种下三滥的手段！沫沫家的宝贝：反正现在顾佳泞和星空一致认为这件事是你做的，尤其是星空，好像觉得这是你为了逼她为耍的手段哦。猛然，欧慕瑄心里一阵不爽，他是那么卑鄙的人么？沫沫家的宝贝：我说，你该不会真的是在追星空吧？看在我们是父子的情分上，我可以免费告诉你，对付星空，硬的绝对不好使，要软哦，无条件的对她好，她绝对乖乖听你的话。沫沫家的宝贝：她的电话我也帮你查到了哦，我发到你手机上。沫沫家的守护神：有事，改天聊！
content_en: Chapter 1 Encounter in a Bar In the past few days, the scandal about Xingkong and Ou Muchuan has not stopped. Ye Qianmo has already developed immunity. She is leisurely drawing her own design at home despite the reports flying around. This morning, the direction of the news seemed to have changed significantly. All the newspaper headlines were about Gu Jia Ning's scandal! Popular actress Gu Jianing uses her body to gain fame! In order to win the film contract, Gu Jiali sacrificed himself for investors! Gu Jiating has no acting skills and only relies on hidden rules to become popular! A piece of vicious entertainment news comes out of thin air, each piece of which can send a popular artist into eighteen levels of hell! The report was full of pictures and texts, and there were also various photos of Gu Jiaching having dinner with many investors. These days, it seems to have become an unspoken rule in the entertainment industry for celebrities to sacrifice their appearance in order to win the favor of investors. However, Gu Jiaching could only accompany him for a meal at most. For other things, she would rather not appear in this drama or accept this advertisement than do it. Her contract has expired, and the new agency has not yet signed a contract with her. Without the protection of the company, Gu Jiali can only be beaten passively! Ye Qianmo was worried about Gu Jianing, so she drove to the apartment where she lived. However, before she got close enough, she was surrounded by reporters blocking the door. "Miss Xingkong, are you here to comfort Miss Gu?" "What do you think of what happened recently?" "I heard that you two are sisters, will you help Miss Gu?" "Ou's media industry occupies almost all the markets in this city, will you ask Mr. Ou for help?" Is Ou's media industry that powerful? So this sudden scandal... Ye Qianmo suddenly thought of Ou Muxuan's words that he would make her beg him. Was he using this method to force her? Despicable and shameless! After breaking through the siege of reporters, Ye Qianmo came to Gu Jiating's apartment. She originally thought that she would huddle in the corner and cry. If not, she would at least cry bitterly. However, what she saw was... this girl had cucumber slices on her face, listening to music and doing yoga! Looking up to see Ye Qianmo, Gu Jianing opened her mouth and ate the cucumber slices beside her mouth, "Sister, do you think my actions are standard?" "What are you doing?" Ye Qianmo was shocked, she was worried to death for her, but the person involved didn't take it seriously at all? "Yoga!" Ye Qianmo pulled off her earphones and stared at her, "Do you know the reports outside?" "Yes," Gu Jianing sat up, "It's okay. I didn't do those things. Let them say it. When they get tired of talking, they will naturally stop talking. If I stand up and explain, it will only make the story darker." She has been in the entertainment industry for so many years, and she is open and honest, so she is not afraid of other people's rumors. "When they say enough, you will be almost dead!" In the entertainment industry, a star's reputation is very important. Once notorious, it will be difficult to become popular again. Gu Jianing sat up, took off the cucumber on her face, changed her usual playful smile, and looked at Ye Qianmo seriously, "I know someone deliberately framed me this time. I have many enemies in the entertainment industry. It's normal for them to take the opportunity to step on me." "Actually..." "But they want to step on me. , it's best to trample me to death, otherwise I will make them pay a bigger price once I stand up." After saying the cruel words, Gu Jia Ning turned to smile, "Hey, you taught me this!" "I'm sorry Jia Ning, this matter... I caused you trouble." Ye Qianmo turned her head guiltily. "Sister?" Gu Jianing didn't understand. "Ou Muxuan wanted me to beg him to get into Ou's women's clothing department, but I refused. So, he wanted to use you to get me to beg him. I'm sorry Jia Ning." "..." Gu Jia Ning was stunned. "But Jia Ning, don't worry, I will find a way, believe me!" There was a grand light in the dark eyes, as firm as a century-old tree. "How?" Gu Jianing chuckled, "What way? Sacrifice your self-esteem and your pride to beg that scumbag?" "I..." If necessary, she can! Gu Jiani held Ye Qianmo's hand, "Sister, if you still treat me as your sister, don't worry about this. If you dare to beg her, I will quit the entertainment industry!" "Jia Ning!" Ye Qianmo looked at her in shock. "Oh sister, you are making a fuss out of a molehill. This time is just a trivial scandal. It's not that serious." Gu Jiaxing looked unconcerned. "After being in the entertainment industry for so long, I haven't experienced any big storms. This is a trivial matter!" The more tolerant she was and the more she thought about her, the more Ye Qianmo blamed herself, damn Ou Muxuan! In the living room, the little baby boy was reading the newspaper and was very confused. Isn't Daddy such a despicable person? He is so proud, he shouldn't bother to use this method to force mommy, right? After thinking for a moment, Little Milkman turned on the computer and logged into the chat system he designed. He found that Ou Muchuan's profile picture was on, so Little Milkman sent him a message. Momo’s baby: Master Luo, are you there? After a minute, the other party finally responded. The patron saint of Momo’s family: What a mess of names these are! Well, Momo’s patron saint is the name given to her dear daddy by the little baby, which means that daddy should protect the little baby’s dear mommy like a patron saint. And his chat avatar was also given by the little baby, a perfect image of a daddy. Momo's baby: Just use it, don't change it, otherwise I can't guarantee that your company's files won't appear on the rival company's computer. Patron Saint of Momo Family: Do you think I will be afraid of your threat? Momo’s baby: Don’t change it, please, just think it’s just to please me! When it's time to be soft, she will never be stingy, especially when the other person is the daddy she has been looking forward to for a long time. The patron saint of Momo’s family: Why should I please you? You are not me.
